The '''Governor's Mansion''' was the residence of [[Barnab Chistor]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the [[Heroes of Cularin]]&mdash;a group of freelance agents who operated within the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]&mdash;assisted in the [[Skirmish in the Blue Star Centre|liberating]] the [[Blue Star Centre]] after it was held hostage by the [[Intarsa League]] criminal faction. To thank them for their efforts, Chistor invited the agents to a formal dinner at the Governor's Mansion.
